items.headline: if an AI sounds confident, it is probably right.
items.hook: Myth: if an AI sounds confident, it is probably right.
points: Reality: models can produce confident-sounding statements that are false or unsupported. This is called a hallucination.
Confidence of tone tells you nothing about accuracy.
items.ask: Which AI myth did you believe the longest?
